title: Eval-Driven Agent Development — Why Evaluate First
titleKn: Eval-ಚಾಲಿತ Agent ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ — ಮೊದಲು ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಏಕೆ
desc: The habit of writing evaluation cases before and alongside the agent, so progress is measured rather than felt.
objectives: Explain vibes-based development and its problems.
Describe an eval as input, expected outcome and a scoring method.
Start with a small, representative set.
objectivesKn: eval = ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್, ನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿತ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ, ಅಂಕ ವಿಧಾನ.

title: Eval-Driven Agent Development — Scoring: Code, Rubrics and LLM Judges
titleKn: Eval-ಚಾಲಿತ Agent ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ — ಅಂಕ: ಕೋಡ್, Rubrics, LLM Judges
desc: Choosing scoring methods, calibrating judges and handling non-determinism with repeated trials.
objectives: Write clear rubrics and calibrate LLM judges.
Use repeated trials for non-deterministic agents.

[{"type":"heading","data":{"textEn":"Eval-Driven Agent Development — Scoring: Code, Rubrics and LLM Judges","textKn":"Eval-Driven Agent Development — Scoring: Code, Rubrics and LLM Judges","level":"H1"}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Lesson Info","headingKn":"Lesson ಮಾಹಿತಿ","bodyEn":"• Type: Concept · Time: ~25 minutes · Part 2 of 3 in Eval-Driven Agent Development","bodyKn":"• Type: Concept · Time: ~25 ನಿಮಿಷಗಳು · Part 2 of 3"}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Code Checks First","headingKn":"ಮೊದಲು ಕೋಡ್ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ","bodyEn":"If success can be checked by code, such as a valid JSON shape, a passing test or a correct number, do that. It is cheap, fast and unbiased.","bodyKn":"ಯಶಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಕೋಡ್‌ನಿಂದ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಬಹುದಾದರೆ (ಮಾನ್ಯ JSON, ಪಾಸ್ ಆಗುವ test, ಸರಿ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ) ಅದನ್ನೇ ಮಾಡಿ. ಅಗ್ಗ, ವೇಗ, ಪಕ್ಷಪಾತವಿಲ್ಲ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Rubrics and Judges","headingKn":"Rubrics ಮತ್ತು Judges","bodyEn":"For qualities such as helpfulness or tone, write a rubric with concrete levels and use a model as judge. Check its scores against human ratings on a sample, and watch for biases such as favouring longer answers.","bodyKn":"ಸಹಾಯಕತೆ ಅಥವಾ ಸ್ವರದಂತಹ ಗುಣಗಳಿಗೆ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಹಂತಗಳ rubric ಬರೆದು ಮಾದರಿಯನ್ನು judge ಆಗಿ ಬಳಸಿ. ಮಾದರಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಮಾನವ ರೇಟಿಂಗ್‌ಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ, ಉದ್ದ ಉತ್ತರಕ್ಕೆ ಒಲವಿನಂತಹ ಪಕ್ಷಪಾತ ಗಮನಿಸಿ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Repeated Trials","headingKn":"ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿತ ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","bodyEn":"A single run of a non-deterministic agent is one sample. Run each case several times and track pass rate and variance, so a lucky pass is not mistaken for reliability.","bodyKn":"ಅನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ agent ನ ಒಂದು run ಒಂದು ಮಾದರಿ ಮಾತ್ರ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಪ್ರಕರಣ ಹಲವು ಬಾರಿ ಚಲಾಯಿಸಿ ಪಾಸ್ ದರ ಮತ್ತು ಭಿನ್ನತೆ ಗಮನಿಸಿ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Outcome Over Path","headingKn":"ಹಾದಿಗಿಂತ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ","bodyEn":"Where possible score the final result, not the exact steps, since many different paths can be valid. Add path checks only for constraints such as never calling a forbidden tool.","bodyKn":"ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಖರ ಹಂತಗಳಲ್ಲ, ಅಂತಿಮ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶಕ್ಕೆ ಅಂಕ ನೀಡಿ. ನಿಷೇಧಿತ tool ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಕರೆಯದಂತಹ ನಿರ್ಬಂಧಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಹಾದಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Key Takeaways","headingKn":"ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳು","bodyEn":"• Use code checks wherever possible.
• Calibrate LLM judges against humans.
• Repeat trials; score outcomes more than paths.","bodyKn":"• ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾದೆಡೆ ಕೋಡ್ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ.
• judges ಮಾನವರಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ.
• ಪ್ರಯೋಗ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿಸಿ; ಫಲಿತಾಂಶಕ್ಕೆ ಅಂಕ."}},{"type":"quiz","data":{"questions":[{"q":"Why prefer code-based scoring?","qKn":"ಕೋಡ್ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಅಂಕ ಏಕೆ ಆದ್ಯತೆ?","opts":["Cheap, fast and unbiased","It is subjective","It needs a judge","It is slower"],"optsKn":["ಅಗ್ಗ, ವೇಗ, ಪಕ್ಷಪಾತವಿಲ್ಲ","ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿನಿಷ್ಠ","judge ಬೇಕು","ನಿಧಾನ"],"correct":0},{"q":"Why repeat trials?","qKn":"ಪ್ರಯೋಗ ಏಕೆ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿಸಬೇಕು?","opts":["A single run is one sample of a non-deterministic agent","To waste money","Trials are decoration","To lengthen reports"],"optsKn":["ಒಂದು run ಅನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ agent ನ ಒಂದು ಮಾದರಿ","ಹಣ ವ್ಯರ್ಥ","ಅಲಂಕಾರ","ವರದಿ ಉದ್ದ"],"correct":0},{"q":"A known judge bias is:","qKn":"ತಿಳಿದ judge ಪಕ್ಷಪಾತ:","opts":["Favouring longer answers","Favouring shorter answers always","None exists","Random deletion"],"optsKn":["ಉದ್ದ ಉತ್ತರಕ್ಕೆ ಒಲವು","ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಚಿಕ್ಕದಕ್ಕೆ ಒಲವು","ಯಾವುದೂ ಇಲ್ಲ","ಯಾದೃಚ್ಛಿಕ ಅಳಿಸುವಿಕೆ"],"correct":0}]}}]

title: Eval-Driven Agent Development — The Loop: Regression Gates and Continuous Improvement
titleKn: Eval-ಚಾಲಿತ Agent ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ — Loop: Regression Gates ಮತ್ತು ನಿರಂತರ ಸುಧಾರಣೆ
desc: Running evals in CI as a gate, tracking results over time and using failures to drive the next iteration.
objectives: Track scores, cost and latency over versions.
Turn every production failure into a new eval.
objectivesKn: ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ gate ಮಾಡಿ.
